column1: # Pragmatics cues for SLM features (prag::feats): word or phrase (lowercase, words separated by spaces) → class.
# Mova's own small list, not taken from others' lexicons. Grounded in the classics: hedges — Lakoff 1973
# ("Hedges"), Hyland 1998; illocutionary force indicating devices (IFID) and indirect acts — Searle 1969, 1975;
# politeness — Brown & Levinson 1987; evaluation — common English evaluative words.
# Classes: hedge · pos · neg (evaluation) · thank · apol · greet · promise · warn · suggest · offer · yes · no ·
# intj (interjection) · say (speech verb in the direct-speech frame).
